keyInsights: Persistence is what we have instead of permanence.
Gravity is a constraint. Constraint is structure. Structure is home.
There is no final view. There is only the viewing. And the viewing is productive.
The water is not the obstacle. The water is the environment that makes navigation meaningful.
The village sees what no villager sees.
